manualReview.scope: Model/editor semantic and pedagogy review of production Lesson 0034 authored from curriculum spec en-fa-A1-LESSON-SPEC-0034; not an independent human or learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: “I also like coffee.” and “I also read books.” are natural ways to express shared preferences/actions after another speaker states them.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian captures also as هم in context, which is natural learner-facing Persian for the additive meaning.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: The lesson focuses on additive also while all content words and I-statements are already familiar.

distractorQuality.evidence: Distractors contrast matching the partner with unrelated or opposite statements, so they test additive meaning.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Two walking-group members comparing simple interests before the walk gives a clear conversational trigger for also.

difficultyFit.evidence: Adding one adverb to known I like/I read frames is an appropriate next A1 recombination step.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Coffee, read and books recur across different predicates while the story shifts to a different pair and purpose.

transferQuality.evidence: Learner first matches a coffee preference, then transfers also into a reading statement and retrieves it hidden.

overallCoherence.evidence: The partner statements create a repeated discourse cue, and every activity requires the learner to express “me too” with also.

learnerExperience.evidence: Static model/editor review only; the lesson flow is focused, but real learner comprehension, speech-recognition behavior and delayed retention remain untested.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
Review is limited to the bounded A1 outcome encoded in this Lesson and does not claim mastery beyond that scope.
Final ElevenLabs prosody and speech-recognition behavior remain unreviewed until the text gate passes.
resolvedFindings: English dialogue and target construction are contextually natural for the declared scenario.
Persian learner-facing meaning preserves the intended bounded sense without promoting a compositional phrase to a lexical word.
The final activity requires hidden retrieval and changes or extends context enough to provide transfer evidence.
Character/story continuity and learner-role assignment are consistent with the declared story metadata.
